scripts.setup: pnpm install && cd backend/core-api && dotnet restore && dotnet tool update --global dotnet-ef && cd ../ai-api && python3 -m venv venv && ./venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend/core-api && dotnet watch run --project OptiLifts.API/OptiLifts.API.csproj
scripts.db:sync: cd backend/core-api && dotnet ef database update --project OptiLifts.Infrastructure --startup-project OptiLifts.API
scripts.db:seed:sql: bash -lc 'set -a; source .env; set +a; cat backend/core-api/OptiLifts.Infrastructure/Database/SqlScripts/seed-demo-data.sql | docker compose exec -T db psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB"'
scripts.test:e2e: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; started_services=0; cleanup() { status=$?; if [ "$started_services" = "1" ]; then pnpm e2e:services:down; fi; exit "$status"; }; trap cleanup EXIT; if [ "${E2E_USE_EXISTING_SERVICES:-0}" = "1" ]; then pnpm exec playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.config.ts; else started_services=1; AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE=${AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE:-false} pnpm e2e:services:up:detached; pnpm exec playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.config.ts; fi'
scripts.test:e2e:ui: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; started_services=0; cleanup() { status=$?; if [ "$started_services" = "1" ]; then pnpm e2e:services:down; fi; exit "$status"; }; trap cleanup EXIT; if [ "${E2E_USE_EXISTING_SERVICES:-0}" = "1" ]; then pnpm exec playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.config.ts --ui; else started_services=1; AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE=${AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE:-false} pnpm e2e:services:up:detached; pnpm exec playwright test --config=e2e/playwright.config.ts --ui; fi'
scripts.e2e:services:webserver: bash -lc 'export AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE="${AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE:-false}"; export E2E_TESTING="true"; export RATE_LIMITING_ENABLED="false"; export NGINX_AUTH_RATE_LIMIT="1000r/s"; export NGINX_GENERAL_RATE_LIMIT="1000r/s"; export NGINX_AUTH_BURST="500"; export NGINX_GENERAL_BURST="1000"; trap "docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml down -v --remove-orphans" EXIT; docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up'
scripts.e2e:services:up:detached: AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE=${AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE:-false} E2E_TESTING=true RATE_LIMITING_ENABLED=false NGINX_AUTH_RATE_LIMIT=1000r/s NGINX_GENERAL_RATE_LIMIT=1000r/s NGINX_AUTH_BURST=500 NGINX_GENERAL_BURST=1000 docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:frontend && pnpm lint:backend && pnpm lint:ai
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm lint:frontend:fix && pnpm lint:backend:fix && pnpm lint:ai:fix
scripts.test:coverage:backend: cd backend/core-api && dotnet test --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage"
